The following events took place in '''103 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Thame Cerulian]] becomes [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Cerulian">According to [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], Thame Cerulian owned a copy of the book between [[115 BBY]] and 103 BBY. Since the book is meant for [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], it can be assumed that Cerulian was Knighted around the time he gave up the ownership of the book.</ref>
